experiment.topic: BTC-USD 1-hour price deviation from 20-period moving average and subsequent return distribution
experiment.hypothesis: BTC-USD 1-hour returns exhibit mean-reversion when price deviates more than 3% from a 20-period moving average, with returns clustering toward the moving average within the next 1-hour period.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: Over a 2020-2026 period, if BTC-USD 1-hour price deviations exceeding 3% from a 20-period moving average consistently result in no mean-reversion (i.e., returns remain above or below the average with no return clustering toward the moving average), the hypothesis is falsified.
